hypothesis: Multi-decadal wave background may modify, but does not define, within-cay local wave-direction coupling.
scope: Exploratory supplementary analysis only; observational interaction, not a causal climate-mode attribution.

background_definition.primary_modifier: wave_exposure_z = mean(z(long-term mean VHM0), z(long-term p90 VHM0))
background_definition.source: WAVERYS daily sampled grid cell per reef

predefined_model.sample: exact Sentinel-2 source contract of the primary directional model
predefined_model.sensitivity: Replace wave_exposure_z with wave_directionality_z; do not combine both modifiers in one model.
predefined_model.estimation: within-cay fixed effects; cay-clustered SE primary, reef and WAVERYS-cell clustered SE sensitivity; BH-FDR within each two-test family
